6-tags-1.tsx.notes: Pills are inline widgets in a Text with right/bottom margin 8, so wrapping and gaps work but there is 8 of trailing space after the last column/row; a tag wider than the line would overflow its horizontal Flex.

6-tags-2.tsx.notes: Selection is keyed by the tag value rather than index, so duplicate tag strings could toggle together; same trailing 8 margin as the inline-Text wrap approach implies.

6-tags-3.tsx.notes: GestureDetector wraps the margin View, but with deferToChild the margin area is not hit-testable so only the pill itself toggles; trailing 8 margin after last column/row.
